body.name: quadratic small-noise witness
body.construction: Under \(P_{\mathrm w,\sigma}\), \(X\sim\operatorname{Unif}[0,1]\), \(Y=X+X^2+\sigma Z\), and \(Z\) has mean zero and density proportional to \(\exp\{-1/(1-z^2)\}\mathbf 1\{|z|<1\}\); take the node interval for \(Y\) to be \([-\sigma,2+\sigma]\).
